subject: BlueWave renewal & expansion — MSA + order form redlines
messages:
From: Elaine Hart <elaine.hart@bluewaveanalytics.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@bluewaveanalytics.com
Date: Wed, 15 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + expansion request: BlueWave renewal and capacity increase

Hi Ava,

Hope you’re well. We’re approaching our renewal window for the account (current term expires 2029-06-30) and want to lock in a 24-month extension with a capacity uplift. Current committed tokens are 2M / month — we’d like to move to 6M / month starting 2029-07-01 and add a short ramp period for burst capacity in Q4.

To move quickly on procurement side, our legal team has asked us to submit redlines to the MSA and the upcoming order form so they can approve internally. I’ve attached a short renewal request that includes the new quantities and our procurement intake form.

Key asks from our side:
- 24 month term (preferred start 2029-07-01)
- 6M tokens / month committed, with burst up to 9M for Q4 (prepaid or on-demand — open to options)
- Confirmation that data residency remains in US regions
- Clarify SLA credits and a request to include a 60-day termination for convenience for our side (if needed)

Can you route to legal and share a redline back? We’re aiming to finish legal review by 2029-05-27 to get PO out in early June.

Attachments: BlueWave_Renewal_Request_20290515.pdf

Thanks,
Elaine Hart
VP Product, BlueWave Analytics
elaine.hart@bluewaveanalytics.com
+1 415 555 0123

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 15 May 2029 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion request: BlueWave renewal and capacity increase

Thanks Elaine — appreciate the context and the timeline. We’re excited to support the uplift. I’ve looped in Ben (AE) and Irene (Legal) to get the redlines processed.

Action plan from our side:
1) Irene/Legal will review the MSA redlines and propose language for the termination/SLA/indemnity items.
2) I’ll circulate a draft order form (attached) with the updated quantities and pricing so procurement can validate cost centers.
3) Once legal and procurement align, we’ll prepare a DocuSign-ready package.

Irene — can you take a first pass on the MSA items Elaine flagged? Target to send tracked changes back by EOD 2029-05-16 so BlueWave has time for internal review.

Attached: Draft_Orderform_v2.docx

Best,
Ava Chen

ava.chen@redwood.com
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2029 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal + expansion request: legal first-pass (MSA redlines)

Ava / Ben — first-pass from Legal after review of Elaine’s note and our standard MSA: see summary + proposed language below. I attached a tracked changes doc.

Summary of recommended positions:
- Term: 24 months is fine; propose effective date 2029-07-01 and auto-renewal for 12 months unless either party provides 90 days’ notice. (This protects Redwood’s long-lead capacity planning.)
- Termination for convenience: we can accept 45 days’ notice (compromise) rather than 60 days requested.
- SLA credits: cap at 12% of recurring monthly fees per incident / 10% annual aggregate. Propose explicit service level definitions and remedy schedule.
- Indemnity: limit customer-contracted third-party IP indemnity to direct damages and exclude consequential damages; maintain mutual indemnity around breaches of confidential data.
- Data residency: confirm US-only hosting; include an appendix referencing region of hosted workloads.
- Audit / compliance: standard SOC 2 attestation; we can provide evidence but resist unlimited audit windows.

Proposed MSA language snippets (for tracked changes):
- "Auto-renewal: Upon expiration of the Initial Term, the Agreement will automatically renew for successive twelve (12) month periods unless either party provides written notice at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term."
- "Termination for convenience: Either party may terminate the Agreement for convenience with forty-five (45) days’ prior written notice to the other party."
- "SLA Credits: Customer's sole and exclusive remedy for failure to meet the SLA shall be service credits not to exceed twelve percent (12%) of the monthly recurring fees for the affected service for the month in which the failure occurred, and the aggregate cap for all service credits in a twelve (12) month period shall not exceed ten percent (10%) of the sum of the fees paid in such period."

See attached: Redline_MSA_changes_20290516.docx (tracked changes). I recommend we send a consolidated package to BlueWave with redline + a short cover note explaining the changes and our rationale.

Irene Choi
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Hart <elaine.hart@bluewaveanalytics.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 17 May 2029 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion request: BlueWave renewal and capacity increase

Hi Elaine — thanks for the submission and the PO timeline. We reviewed internally and attached a consolidated redline with tracked changes to the MSA and the updated order form. A few quick clarifications and proposed compromises to help move toward sign: 

1) Term & termination: We can move to a 24-month committed term starting 2029-07-01. Redwood proposes auto-renewal language with 90-day opt-out, and we can accept a shorter termination-for-convenience notice of 45 days (Irene’s recommendation).

2) SLA credits: We understand the request for stronger SLA protection. Our legal team proposes a cap at 12% of monthly fees per incident with a 10% aggregate annual cap. We’re open to a single uplift to 15% if BlueWave can accept a maximum of two qualifying incidents in a rolling 12 months before escalation to execs.

3) Indemnity and data residency: We retained mutual indemnities for data breaches and limited other liability per our standard terms. We’ll confirm US-only hosting and include a data residency appendix in the order form.

4) Logistics: For the capacity increase, ops needs ~4 weeks lead time to provision dedicated capacity pools / quota changes. For burst capacity, we can provide on-demand bursts but recommend discussing a committed burst buffer for Q4 to avoid throttling.

Next steps:
- Attached: Combined_Redline_BlueWave_20290517.docx (MSA + Order Form tracked changes)
- DocuSign link for order form: https://docusign.example/start?envelopeId=0a1b2c3d

Please review and tell us which of the two SLA credit paths above you prefer (12% with standard cap, or 15% with limited incident allowance). We’d like to finalize by 2029-05-27 to keep the timeline for June PO.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Director, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Elaine Hart <elaine.hart@bluewaveanalytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@bluewaveanalytics.com, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion request: BlueWave renewal and capacity increase

Ben / Ava — thanks for the fast turnaround and the detailed redline. We reviewed with procurement and legal. A few outcomes from our side: 

- Term: OK with 24 months starting 2029-07-01.
- Termination: we would prefer 60 days’ notice rather than 45; is there room to accept 60 days if we agree to a small commitment adjustment?
- SLA credits: procurement is pushing for 15% cap on monthly credits (they want stronger remediation options). If Redwood can accept 15% but require that BlueWave escalates to execs after two qualifying incidents, we can probably move forward.
- Capacity lead time: 4 weeks provisioning is fine as long as Redwood can guarantee the capacity pool by 2029-07-01. We will submit PO once MSA and order form are signed. Attached is our PO and procurement intake: BlueWave_PO_20290520.pdf

We’re aiming to sign by 2029-05-31. If you can confirm a plan for SLA credits and a final termination window by COB 2029-05-21, procurement will route the PO.

Thanks,
Elaine Hart
VP Product, BlueWave Analytics
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: RE: BlueWave renewal — next steps and internal approvals

Team — quick internal summary and proposed final positions for exec approval: 

1) SLA credits: Counter to BlueWave at 12% monthly / 10% annual cap is our legal starting point. However, given the strategic nature of the account and the uplift, propose we accept 13% monthly with an annual cap of 11% as a one-time concession for this renewal, conditional on BlueWave’s escalation agreement (exec notice after two qualifying incidents).
2) Termination: we can accept 60 days for convenience only if we secure a firm 12-month minimum commitment on billing (i.e., if they terminate in first 12 months then pro-rata charge for remaining months). Alternatively, keep 45 days and offer a small one-time onboarding credit.
3) Capacity: ops confirms 4 weeks provisioning but needs the signed order form by 2029-06-03 to meet a 2029-07-01 start date. Ops lead: lauren_bishop@redwood.com to own scheduling.

Irene / Ben — please finalize the tracked MSA with the 13% SLA language and the termination-for-convenience language options. I’ll push to execs for approval of the concession and share the final package to BlueWave with the DocuSign link. Goal: signature by 2029-05-31 and full provisioning schedule by 2029-06-10.

Attachments referenced: Combined_Redline_BlueWave_20290517.docx, Redline_MSA_changes_20290516.docx

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com
